name: AI Usage
author: AkitaOnRails
description: Multi-provider AI plan usage and balances in a native Omarchy Quattro panel. Needs the ai-usagebar binary as well as this plugin: omarchy pkg aur add ai-usagebar-bin

barWidget.description: Usage windows, reset countdowns, balances, and provider switching for every provider configured in ai-usagebar. This is the display frontend only — install the binary with omarchy pkg aur add ai-usagebar-bin.

schema.label: Provider or account id
schema.description: Optional id from ai-usagebar usage --json (for example openai or anthropic@work). Leave blank to switch between all configured entries.

schema.label: Show usage value
schema.description: Show the selected provider's percentage or balance next to the icon in the top bar.

schema.label: Show provider name
schema.description: Show the selected provider's short code (cld, gpt, zai, agy) before the usage value, the way Waybar's {vendor_short} does. Off by default.

schema.label: Show all providers
schema.description: Show every configured provider's icon and usage in the top bar at once, instead of cycling one at a time. Off by default.

schema.label: Color-code usage by level
schema.description: Paint bar values, panel meters, and the tooltip green → yellow → orange → red as usage climbs, using your Omarchy theme. Turn off for a single foreground color. Off by default.

schema.label: Top bar usage window
schema.description: Which quota window the top bar shows. Auto keeps the highest percent; 5-hour pins the session/rolling window; weekly pins the 7-day window; monthly pins the monthly pool where one exists. Falls back to highest when a vendor lacks the pinned window.

schema.label: Show Cursor Models
schema.description: Show the Cursor Models pool in the top bar and tooltip. The open panel always lists every pool. At least one Cursor pool stays visible.

schema.label: Show Other Models
schema.description: Show the Other Models pool in the top bar and tooltip. The open panel always lists every pool. At least one Cursor pool stays visible.

schema.label: Show On-Demand
schema.description: Show prepaid on-demand usage in the top bar and tooltip. The open panel always lists every pool. At least one Cursor pool stays visible.
